name: Musashi
description: The Leios test network. Three relays, one per continent, named after their AWS regions' cities (Frankfurt, N. Virginia, Tokyo); the earlier ids europe, americas and asia still work in specs. Nodes listen for node-to-node on 3010 and serve node-to-client only on their local socket, reached over SSH. Both are open to allow-listed addresses only. Hosts are a snapshot of 2026-10-13 (after the 13:03 UTC relaunch) and change when an instance is stopped.
